description: Conformance vectors for mythos.recovery-receipt/v2, generated by mythos-core (mythos_core/recovery_receipt.py, tests/recovery_receipt_v2_vectors.py). v2 is v1 with one rule more: every engine entry names its key id, so every support vouches for its record (mythos_core.provenance: signed or stated). Each key is Ed25519 with the private seed SHA-256 of its phrase: test keys, public by construction, never a real one. Envelopes are DSSE with the payload and signature written as hex. 'valid': the inputs build_receipt takes, the receipt it makes and its envelope, and the same receipt with an engine entry added that names no key, refused. 'invalid': a valid receipt with one thing changed, signed as it stands, refused with its 'verdict' and 'code'. 'v1_beside_v2': each v1 receipt (tests/vectors/recovery-receipt-v1.json), its standing and what unvouched_support finds in it, its inputs built as v2, and the v1 receipt under v2's payload type. 'release_rule': every state, held and gap, with every support vouching and with one that does not. Every name here is invented.
unreadable_finding: a voucher is one of ('signed', 'stated'), and a string of 7 characters is not: anything else, nothing on record included, is a gap
